question.text: A term is randomly chosen from the expansion of <math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mroot><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></mroot><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mroot><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></mroot></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>20</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> If the probability that it is a rational term is <math><mi>P</mi></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>420</mn><mi>P</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Total number of terms =21
Number of rational terms =2 (9th and 21st)
Required probability P=221
